description: github_core CI/nightly boot-and-test profile (req-plugin-extdev-repo-ci; consumed by tap's plugin-ci.yml boot-and-test job). Installs github_core EDITABLE from the CI checkout at _external/github_core so the suite runs against THIS repo's HEAD rather than a released tag, plus identity_core, which github_core declares in depends_on and imports at collection time for the oidc_issuer convergence node. Population is seed-only: CI runs with an empty secrets root and never fires collectors, so there is no fire-collector step and correspondingly no required_secrets (coherence rule req-boot-required-secrets-4). NO profile_kind: it is an allowlist token that only ever WIDENS — `dev_local` is what permits `enroll_admin --import-dev-passkey` to bind an admin credential (req-tap-auth-passkey-dev-bootstrap-4). Nothing here invokes it, but a CI profile has no use for the affordance and omitting the key leaves the guard fail-closed. Sources are pinned by COMMIT, not tag: a tag can be moved or recreated, and this profile is what makes that code execute inside a job that holds TAP_CORE_RO_PAT.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). Install-only substrate: the oidc_issuer convergence node github_core mints, and the source type ENABLED_ON points at. Declared in github_core's depends_on. No GRIFT seed. Pinned to the commit v0.1.1 pointed at on 2026-08-28 rather than to the tag itself — install hooks run in CI, and a moved tag would change what executes without this file changing.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core), installed EDITABLE from the CI checkout so the in-package suite runs against this repo's HEAD, not a released wheel.

steps.note: The repo landing page GRIFT. Seeding it is what proves the bundle parses and its panel types resolve against a real registry.
